4. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code would not attract in the case of Gutka.

opennyai_summary.12_August_2022__ANALYSIS:
It is also argued that the issue of applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code in Gutka cases is sub judice before the Honourable Apex Court.
There are contradictory views of this Court on the issue of applicability of Section 328 of the IPC in the cases of Gutka.
opennyai_summary.12_August_2022__decision:
In view thereof, the applicants may be granted interim protection.
The Hon'ble Apex Court is seized with the issue.
Hence, the applicants deserve to be granted interim protection.

opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
Gutka is not harmful to the life except the surmises of the officers from the Food Safety Department.
There are no elements to attract Section 328 of the 925-ABA-1028-22 Indian Penal Code in the present case.
Therefore, the anticipatory bail may be granted to the applicants.
5. The allegations against the applicants have been made that the co-accused told the Investigating Officer that the applicants had supplied Gutka to him.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
There are two views as regards applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code and the said issue is seized with the Honourable Supreme Court.
In fact, there is no direct evidence against the applicants.

Considering the allegations levelled against the applicants and the role played by them,
